issue.title: SASE-owned inline-then-escalate for ToolRuns: sase tool run --detach, ceiling-bounded sase tool wait, sase monitor start --join
issue.description:
Proposed by phase sase-177.4 (epic sase-177; plan "Follow-ups" item 3; the `sase tool`
roadmap's E2). Remove the need for an up-front inline-vs-monitor guess:

- `sase tool run --detach` starts a ToolRun without blocking.
- `sase tool wait <id>` waits bounded by the caller's synchronous ceiling.
- `sase monitor start --join <id>` adopts an already-running ToolRun into a monitor.

This lets an agent start a check inline and escalate to a monitor without cancelling
and rerunning it, making the cancel-and-restart failure mode (46+ Muse occurrences Sep
20-23) impossible. Likely crosses the sase-core boundary for ToolRun state.
